pred_ddx.label: Giant Cell Tumor of the Tendon Sheath

Giant Cell Tumor of the Tendon Sheath: The mass's location within the fourth extensor tendon compartment, its multilobulated and mildly echogenic appearance with vascularity on ultrasound, and the clinical presentation of a slowly enlarging, firm, and tender mass are characteristic of a giant cell tumor of the tendon sheath.
Ganglion Cyst: Although less likely, a ganglion cyst could present as a firm, tender mass and might show some vascularity on ultrasound, but the specific location within the tendon compartment and the multilobulated appearance are more indicative of a giant cell tumor.
